posts.text:
📣 XCPETS UPDATE 1/4: the GEAR FORGE is open 🔨{chad}

Got a mountain of gear just sitting in your closet doing NOTHING? Not anymore.

⚡ Gear up for real: one burn puts your best spare pieces on your pets ON-CHAIN, strongest pets first. It counts in fights now. A pet never gets a worse piece than it already wears.
💥 Smash: melt spare junk into Gear Dust (Common 1, Uncommon 3, Rare 9, Legendary 27). One copy of every piece is always kept.
🧪 Fuse: 3 copies of a piece become 1 piece one rarity UP.
🎲 Dust roll: 100 Dust = a free gear roll for any pet.

Each one is a tiny 1-dander burn. Your pets have been fighting naked. Fix that 😤

📍 xcpets.fun → Rare Room → Closet → Gear Forge

📣 XCPETS UPDATE 2/4: the Pantheon is now a WAR 👑⚔️

🏛️ All 21 seats full? Rise anyway. Your new God just has no seat... yet.
⚔️ Hit Challenge on any throne. The fight happens right away, in the same block. Win and you SIT, and the old God falls 💔 Only the seat is on the line: no gear lost. One challenge per God per day.
🎶 Homer got a stage and a lyre, and he sings every fall and every usurper. Get yourself a song.

🛡️ Unleash got kinder too: tick the Mythics you DON'T want eaten and the zombie never touches them.
🧟 A zombie waiting for its meal can't be hunted anymore.
⏰ The 30-day waits on Unleash and Mythic God are GONE.

The gods are seated. Go take a chair {homer}

📣 XCPETS UPDATE 3/4: opening boxes is way better 📦{pepe}

✅ Box reveal now starts in KEEP mode: tap the pets you love, hit Keep, the rest go to the Discard pile. Legendaries, Mythics, geared, starred and weird finds are always kept, so no 1-in-777 gets swept by accident.
⚡ 3 Shock Boxes at once? Every box gets its own reveal. Miss a pop-up and it comes back as a little pill.
🗑️ Your Discard pile now shows EVERY pet you discarded on chain, and Restore brings one back.
🏷️ Special pets wear badges up top: 👑 Legendary Mix, twins, throwbacks, mutations. Tap one to see why it's special.
🧬 Cross pets show their mixed name (Star-Lord Pigeon, not Snibby).

Go check your old hatches. You might own something rare and not know it 👀

📣 XCPETS UPDATE 4/4: smoother, safer, no more burning for nothing 🧈{doge}

🛑 Before you sign, the game now checks EVERY feed, discard and pick burn. If it would do nothing, it won't let you send it. Your XCPETS are safe.
🔥 Fire Sale burns that land up to 6 blocks late still get the sale price.
🍽️ "Do it all in one burn" on feeding really opens Sign now.
🧊 Rare Room, breeding, fights and raids no longer freeze, even on giant wallets.
🧈 Pages stop jumping around, and pop-ups wait while you're tapping.
👋 The "Say WAGMI" pop-up is gone.
☁️ If the game server ever goes down, pages still load from a backup copy.
⚔️ Every raid ATTACK button really attacks.
🏆 Rankings "This week" is back.

Bug? Type /bug to HatchBot. We fix fast 🛠️
